text:
Maya: kicking off RC creation for candidate rc3. CI green, smoke tests pass.
Liam: artifacts pushed to gcr://redwood/rc/rc3 and s3://artifacts/rc3.tar.gz
Sofia: QA ran regression suite, two flaky tests noted (ui-session-timeout) but OK for release after manual verification.
Ravi: perf benchmarks: p95 +3% under sustained load, might be kv-cache warmup.
SRE-Oncall: recommend warmup hooks and a conservative ramp plan. If 5xx > 0.5% we rollback.
Maya: draft release notes: https://go/redwood/release/rc3-draft (please review)
Liam: added rollout plan in the thread, TL;DR -> canary 10% for 15m, ramp 25% for 15m, 50% for 30m, then 100% if green.
Sofia: pinning runtime image in deploy config to avoid drift: runtime: "rtm:1.18.2". Also pin model artifact tag: rc3-20260311.
Maya: signoff checklist: QA ✅, perf ✅ (with warmup), security scan ✅, infra smoke ✅
Liam: putting the promotion window: change window 2026-03-11 18:00-20:00 UTC. No DB migrations in this cut.
deploy-bot: Deploy request created by Liam: /promote rc3 -> prod (canary=10%). Request id: dpl-4821.
Maya: added emergency rollback plan to the release notes: rollback to rc2 tag + reinstate circuit breakers.
Ravi: warming KV caches with `curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/internal/warm?pattern=top100` in canary.
SRE-Oncall: alert rules: if error_rate > 0.5% for 3m or tail_latency p99 > 2x baseline, we escalate and hold rollout.
Liam: I approve the promo, will watch metrics for first 45m.
Sofia: small config snippet for the rollout, dropping here for ops:
```
rollout:
  steps:
    - pct: 10
      duration: 15m
    - pct: 25
      duration: 15m
    - pct: 50
      duration: 30m
    - pct: 100
      duration: 10m
  health_checks:
    error_rate_threshold: 0.005
    p99_latency_factor: 2.0
```
Maya: deploying now, will trigger warmup hooks first.
deploy-bot: Promotion started (dpl-4821) by Liam. Step: canary 10% -> applying.
Liam: canary deployed. Initial metrics: errors 0.02%, p95 within expected.
Ravi: KV warm executed across one region, hit cache hit ratio +12%.
SRE-Oncall: minor GC spike on one pod, no user impact, watching.
Sofia: rolling out to 25% now per plan.
deploy-bot: Rollout: 25% applied. Next check in 15m.
Liam: after 25% window metrics still green. No regressions in trace samples.
Maya: proceeding to 50%. All runbooks ready.
deploy-bot: Rollout: 50% applied.
SRE-Oncall: monitoring shows small CPU bump but error rate steady.
Ravi: autoscaler added 2 nodes to handle burst, all healthy.
Sofia: updated release notes with final changelog and exec summary.
Maya: ok to go 100%
deploy-bot: Final step: 100% traffic routed to rc3 (dpl-4821). Promotion complete.
Liam: tagging release commit and publishing release notes: https://go/redwood/releases/rc3
Maya: closing thread, publishing postmortem template and runbook updates.
SRE-Oncall: added rollback playbook to runbook: `runbook/rc-rollback.md` with steps + safeties.
Ravi: great job team :tada:
Sofia: :ship:
